'''Cactobodhi''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cactoczar]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Having attained enlightenment, Cactobodhi is now without thorns and simply passes the flower season peacefully with eyes closed. While those who are foolish enough still approach to get skewered, know that it's done with great compassion."

Cactobodhi is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Cactobodhi was added to the game on 10/7/2026 alongside [[Popa]] and [[Armovolve]].
